name: Midnight omens
source:
Would you like your fortune read? You encounter a charming woman that would like to ask you a few question beforehand. Once a day you can come here and ask about your fate.

Don't let negative fortunes ruin your day.

[From [url=https://corrocerous.itch.io/midnight-omens]itch.io[/url]]
